Our Heritage

Amarnath & Co. — A Legacy of Fine Fabrics Since 1959

For more than six decades, Amarnath & Co. has been part of the story of Delhi’s Cloth Market. Set in the lanes of Ganesh Bazar, Chandni Chowk, we have grown by doing one thing patiently: helping people find the right fabric.

From flowing curtain fabrics and sheers to sofa cloth and upholstery materials, our range spans a wide variety of textures, colours and designs. Whether you are dressing a single window or sourcing for a full project, you are welcome to touch the cloth, compare, and take your time — with personal guidance whenever you want it.

  • 60+ years of experience
  • Wholesale and retail expertise
  • Wide range of fabrics, textures, colours and designs
  • Personal guidance for selecting the right fabric
  • A trusted destination in Chandni Chowk’s Cloth Market

Fabric Guide

Choosing the Right Fabric

A few simple things to think about before you decide.

Curtains

Consider light control, privacy, drape, pattern, and room ambience.

Sofas

Prioritise durability, comfort, texture, colour, and everyday use.

Upholstery

Select fabrics suited to furniture type, usage, and desired finish.

Blackout

Ideal for bedrooms, media rooms, and spaces needing reduced light.

Sheers

Perfect for soft natural light and layered window styling.

Not sure which fabric suits your space? Send us a photo or your requirement on WhatsApp.

How to Reach Us

Right in the lanes of Ganesh Bazar, Old Delhi.

  • By MetroGet off at Chandni Chowk Metro Station (Yellow Line), then walk about 6 minutes through Khari Baoli’s vibrant lanes. You’ll spot us right in Ganesh Bazar.
  • By BusGet down at Old Delhi Railway Station (DTC stop), just 8 minutes away. Take buses 106, 114, 130 or 816 and ask for Ganesh Bazar — locals will happily guide you.
Pro tip: once you’re near Chandni Chowk, just say “Amarnath & Co” — every local knows the name.
